Class InventoryService

java.lang.Object
com.store.inventory.service.InventoryService
public class InventoryService extends Object
Business logic of the inventory: add, view, update, delete and set status.

Every change is validated and then written to the InventoryRepository. The class contains no user-interface code so it can be tested on its own.

Author:
Mashal and Umaina
